title: The Walk Down
summary: Waders that don't fit, Vetch's one-line briefing at Dock C, and ten minutes on the duty launch across the harbour.
goal: They've kitted up, heard the job from Vetch, and crossed to the hatch on the old town's quay.
howToPlay: Quiet and a little funny. The waders don't fit. **Then the crossing: let them talk.**

intro.where: The night lockup and Dock C on the island, then the launch across the harbour.
intro.readAloud: The night lockup is a counter, a single bulb and a clerk who has already issued everything worth having. Six pairs of waders and one chit to sign.
intro.landmark: Dock C's gate, lit, at the bottom of the hill.

carriesIn.then: The launch puts in at the Old Landing, where they came off the ferry. It looks different at night.

position.note: The night lockup, then Dock C. Not yet sited.

cast.label: Section Officer Vetch
cast.role: Waiting at Dock C to see them off.

brief.wants: Section Nine down the hatch on time, with nothing they can complain about on paper.
brief.opensWith: "Twenty-one hundred. You're on time. Don't let it go to your heads."

willDiscuss.note: "Power to the drainage line. Clear the feed. Report to me when it runs."

willNotDiscuss.why: "Drains. Drains have things in them. Lamps on before you go down."

voice.register: Clipped and procedural. Never wrong in his own account.
samples: "Lamps on before you go down, not after."

brief.statblock: Proposed: level 3, an officer, non-combat. Perception DC 19, Will DC 19, Deception DC 19. Striking him ends in a hearing, not a fight.

cast.label: Taka
cast.role: Sees them off at the lockup door.

beats.text: Every pair of waders is the wrong size. Let whoever looks first find out how wrong. <trig id="drains-waders"/> <trig id="drains-wearing"/>
If there's room for it, Taka catches them at the door: "Told you. Waders." Nothing else. <trig id="taka-sees-them-off"/>

At Dock C, Vetch gives them the job and puts them on the duty launch. <trig id="vetch-at-dock-c"/> <trig id="drains-at-dock-c"/> <trig id="drains-job-power"/> <trig id="drains-job-feed"/> <trig id="drains-job-report"/>
beats.readAloud: "Power to the drainage line. Clear the compactor feed. Report to me when it runs." He ticks something on his clipboard. "The launch will take you over. I'll be at the top."
beats.note: If someone refuses to go: "Noted." He writes it down, slowly. "Report to the Deputy Director's office. Now. The rest of you, the launch."

beats.text: Read the crossing, then ask each player what their character does with the ten minutes.
beats.readAloud:
The launch is cold and loud and smells of oil. Behind you are the island's lights, and Hangar Two's doors standing open under floodlights, with a Frame inside on its gantry. Ahead, the old town is dark down at the waterline. The crew don't talk. It's ten minutes across black water.

Across the water, every dog in the old town is barking, all of them at one dark street near the waterline. Then they stop, all at once.
beats.note:
Plant: It's the side street the dogs wouldn't walk down this afternoon. Say nothing about it.
Secret: The Watcher's swarm is thick on that street tonight.

outro.endsWhen: The launch bumps against the old town's quay.

tracks.why: If they used the crossing on each other.

transition.line: A hatch in the quay, already open, with a ladder going down.

outro.onwards: Flood Tunnel Clearance, down the hatch.
writeDown: Anything said on the crossing worth calling back.

position.note: At the hatch on the old town's quay.

exceptions.why: A deliberate relax beat before the fight: the waders are comedy and the crossing is talk, so nothing in it is rolled.

temptations.text: Whoever has the biggest pair can't get up the launch's ladder in them. The crew haul them over by the straps, and nobody lets it drop for the rest of the crossing.
Halfway across, the launch idles for no reason the pilot will give, with the old town's front dark ahead. Let the table have the quiet and see what they say into it.
If the table liked Taka, he's at the door with one small thing pressed into somebody's hand, and no explanation but a shrug.

reactionPrompts.text: The six talking among themselves on the crossing.

notes: The calm before the fight, and a little comedy. Dock C and the night lockup are on the island and not yet sited; the hatch is on the old landing, on the mainland.
